scope: Qualified installed Sensor11 BaseSensor activation/getter/deadline observations. Rust exposes ordinary loaded IMU activation only; full framework and native whole-IMUServer activation parity remain open.

original.ported_subset: Default IsActive()==true and SetActive(false) getter observations only. Constructor identity, name, frame, topic and other assertions remain unported.

public_reproduction.qualification: Same18 actual rows and loaded libraries. Public filename changes ELF identity; each ELF is recorded independently. Compiler/reference-binary checks retain installed-build lineage, not a clean SDK rebuild.

loaded_contract.inactive: Ordinary acquisition consumes no deadline, sample sequence or noise draw; cached samples are not republished.
loaded_contract.global_admission: Raw due+connected prepass retains native Imu.cc ordering, including inactive peers.
loaded_contract.velocity: Physics velocity history remains current while acquisition is inactive.
loaded_contract.reset: Rust loaded-world reconstruction restores initial active=true; this local lifecycle contract is not proven native whole-server activation parity.
loaded_contract.forced: Native forced rows remain reference-only; no forced Rust API is exposed.

acceptance: Independent native, source, runtime and full coverage reviews approved:279 Rust/88 tooling tests, all9 crates strictly above95% lines/regions. Current-source default-active SDK stream measurements and lossless public projection are separately reviewed. Acceptance requires final metadata binding, the normal protected hook and exact hosted CI for the final commit.
